title: Ravens S Malaki Starks: Rookie year didn't meet my standard, I'm expecting better this year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens S Malaki Starks: Rookie year didn't meet my standard, I'm expecting better this year
sources.description: Safety Malaki Starks jumped right into a leading role for the Ravens during his rookie season, but the 2025 first-round pick wasn't thrilled with his overall body of work in 2026.
